channel.title: Astrofray | Devlog & Updates
channel.description: Official devlogs, patch notes, and Closed Preview announcements for Astrofray by Ezrok Studios.

item.title: Version 0.3.2 Live: Overhauled Boss Explosions & Target Tracking
item.description:
Astrofray v0.3.2 has been deployed with key combat feedback improvements:

  • Reworked Boss Explosions: Dreadnought takedowns are now significantly punchier with overhauled visual FX and shockwaves.
  • Off-Screen Target Indicators: Dynamic chevron markers point toward out-of-view hostiles so you never lose the fight.
  • Performance & Polish: Frame-rate optimizations for dense bullet curtains and minor bug fixes.

item.title: Version 0.3.1 Live: Combat Polish & Mid-Battle Settings
item.description:
Update v0.3.1 brings quality-of-life adjustments:

  • Better Combat Visuals: Revamped space backdrop and clearer hit feedback upon taking hull damage.
  • Mid-Combat Settings: Adjust audio, controls, and display options directly from the in-combat pause menu.
  • Combat Resume Fix: Resolved an edge-case bug where resuming a saved encounter prematurely triggered victory.
